# watchpoint_user_group (Resource)

A user group used for organizing members and (optionally) mapping to an SSO group. Membership and role assignments are managed outside this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_user_group" "example" {
  name          = "Engineering"
  description   = "Engineering team"
  sso_group_id  = "engineering-team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the group.
- `sso_group_id` (String) Identifier of the SSO group this group maps to, if any.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Group ID.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the group is active.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_user_group.example grp_001
```
